SalesInvoiceItemRequest.description: Request model for Sales Invoice Line Item

id.description: Existing invoice line ID. Used during update to preserve line identity.

itemId.description: Item master ID (optional, for inventory reference)

hsnSacId.description: HSN/SAC Master ID for tax classification

itemName.description: Item or service name (optional, defaults to description or item master name)

unitPrice.description: Unit price in invoice currency (4 decimal precision)

unit.description: Unit of measure (e.g., PCS, KG, SQM)

warehouseId.description: Warehouse ID where the item is stored

customerId.description: Customer ID (must belong to same company)

invoiceNumber.description: Unique invoice number per company (e.g., INV-2026-001). Auto-generated if not provided.

dueDate.description: Payment due date (must be >= invoice date)

invoiceCurrency.description: Invoice currency code (optional, uses company base currency if not provided)

exchangeRate.description: Exchange rate if invoiceCurrency differs from company base currency (precision: 13 integer, 6 decimal)

placeOfSupply.description: Place of supply for GST determination (state code or state name)

InvoiceTaxRequest.description: Request model for invoice tax details

gstSlabId.description: GST slab ID used for tax calculation

taxableAmount.description: Taxable amount for the invoice tax line

cgstAmount.description: CGST amount for the tax line

sgstAmount.description: SGST amount for the tax line

igstAmount.description: IGST amount for the tax line

cessAmount.description: CESS amount for the tax line

HsnSacMasterRequest.description: Request object for HSN / SAC master records

code.description: HSN or SAC code (optional for create API, auto-generated if omitted)

gstSlabId.description: GST slab ID mapped to the HSN/SAC

companyId.description: Company identifier the report is generated for

branchId.description: Branch identifier to narrow the report to a single branch

gstRegistrationId.description: GST registration identifier to narrow the report to a single registration

financialYearId.description: Financial year identifier; used to resolve the default report period

invoiceType.description: Invoice type filter: SALES, PURCHASE, CREDIT_NOTE, DEBIT_NOTE or ALL

stateCode.description: Place of supply / GST state code filter (2 digit code)

customerId.description: Customer identifier to narrow the report to a single customer

vendorId.description: Vendor identifier to narrow the report to a single vendor

GstReportRequest.description: Request payload for GST report endpoints

Gstr1ReportResponse.description: GSTR-1 report data with records, summary, and pagination

summary.description: Aggregated summary of all filtered records

Gstr1SummaryResponse.description: Aggregated totals for the GSTR-1 report

totalInvoices.description: Total number of invoices matching the filter

AppliedFiltersResponse.description: Strongly-typed metadata for the applied filters during report generation

GeneralLedgerResponse.description: Response containing the general ledger report details and transactions

accountId.description: Account UUID if generated for a specific account

transactions.description: List of ledger transactions within the period

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the report was generated

LedgerTransactionResponse.description: Details of a single ledger transaction

accountCode.description: Account code, omitted if same as report level

accountName.description: Account name, omitted if same as report level

currency.description: Currency code, omitted if same as report level

createdBy.description: UUID of the user who created this entry

postedAt.description: Timestamp when the entry was posted
